text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it was opening a routine probe into the following corporate ventures under the European Union's merger rules, which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions:
-- Agos Itafinco, an Italian consumer credit joint venture between Caisse Nationale du Credit Agricole (CNCA), Banco Banco Ambrosiano Veneto SpA and Banque Sofinco (Notified on April 4)

-- Warner Lusomundo Cines de Espana, a joint venture between Warner Bros. International Theaters, which belongs to Time Warner Inc, Portuguese media group Lusomundo SA and Spanish pay-television firm Sogecable to build and develop multiplex cinemas in Spain (Notified on April 8)
The Commission has about a month to approve the deal or start a full probe.
